title: Number of Subarrays With AND Value of K
summary: Given an array of integers, count the subarrays where the bitwise AND of the elements equals a specified integer k.
statement: Given an array of integers, count the subarrays where the bitwise AND of the elements equals a specified integer k.
constraints: nums is a nonempty nonnegative-integer array and k is nonnegative.
Count nonempty contiguous subarrays whose bitwise AND equals k.
Different index ranges count separately even when their values are identical.
hints: All subarrays ending at the current index arise from the singleton or by extending a previous ending subarray.
Map each distinct ending AND value to the number of ranges producing it; equal values merge.
The recurrence preserves every left endpoint and AND is idempotent, so combining equal states loses no counts or future behavior.
editorial: The recurrence preserves every left endpoint and AND is idempotent, so combining equal states loses no counts or future behavior.

tests.explanation: All six nonempty subarrays have AND one.
The two single threes and the three ranges ending after index zero have AND three, totaling five.
